title: Why do we smile when we are happy?
hook: Hello friends! When I am happy my mouth curls up by itself. Why do we smile?
answer: When you feel happy, your brain sends a tiny message to the little muscles in your cheeks. They pull the corners of your mouth up, and your eyes crinkle too. A smile is like a little flag that tells everyone, I feel good! When a friend sees it, their cheeks often smile right back.
wowFact: Here is a wow fact! It works the other way too. A big smile when you feel grumpy can make your brain feel a little happier.
experiment: Try this! Look in a mirror and make the biggest, silliest smile you can. Hold it and count to ten. Do you feel a tiny bit happier? Try it on a friend!

onScreenText.experiment: Try it: a giant mirror smile

description: Bolt explores what happens in our face and brain when we smile, and why smiles spread between friends. Then he tries a silly mirror smile.
